topic: Training half-present: scrolling the phone between sets, body in the gym but mind somewhere else; we give the set in front of us our full attention and let everything else wait until the session is done
figure: Marcus Aurelius, Roman emperor and Stoic, 121-180 AD (Meditations 2.5: put your whole mind on the task in front of you, with care and seriousness, and free yourself from every other distraction; do each thing as if it were the last of your life, without aimlessness). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: ตัวอยู่ในยิม
แต่ใจอยู่ในมือถือ
ทำเซตตรงหน้าให้เต็มที่
เรื่องอื่นรอได้
